rix.text: Angrath, trapped on Ixalan for fourteen years, watched Orazca rise from the valley with Huatli, and told her that every group on the plane was just ants on an anthill.

He led her through the space between planes to glimpse Kaldheim, explained that freedom starts with knowing you are trapped, and revealed that he wanted to see his daughters, whom he had not seen in fourteen years.

Near Orazca they met Saint Elenda, who emerged from a bat-marked tomb, and then Angrath attacked Huatli with a chain and ran ahead to Orazca, where Huatli's dinosaur bowled him over and pinned him, until he burned through it.

When he, Huatli, Tishana and Vona all touched the Immortal Sun, a surge of energy passed through them, and after it vanished Angrath cursed the plane and planeswalked away, free at last, returning home to his foundry and his daughters Rumi and Jamira.
